dmn_experiences.title: The Manchester Craft Beer Experience
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of Manchester's craft beer venues with tastings across several stops, covering the brewing process and a range of beer styles. Groups are capped at 25 people.
highlights: Guided tour of Manchester's craft beer scene
Tastings of styles from IPAs to wild-fermented beers
Small groups of up to 25 people
Wheelchair-accessible route of about one mile
